query:
SELECT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM device_marketplace_session dms
             JOIN device d ON d.org_id = dms.org_id AND d.id = dms.device_id
             WHERE dms.org_id = $1 AND dms.marketplace = $2
               AND dms.status = 'connected' AND d.revoked_at IS NULL
           ) AS "connected!"
